hooks.name: precedent-bootstrap
hooks.description: Precedent: run tools/bootstrap.sh at session start. Its output goes to stderr because Gemini CLI parses a hook's stdout as JSON.

hooks.name: precedent-stop-git-check
hooks.description: Precedent: refuse to end a turn with uncommitted, untracked or unpushed work. Exit 2 with the reasons on stderr makes Gemini CLI retry the turn with them as the prompt, the same contract as Claude Code's Stop hook.
